basic_identification.full_title: Alternating Current Direct Connected Static Prepayment Meters for Active Energy (Class 1 and Class 2) — Specification (First Revision)

scope.summary: This standard prescribes the requirements, test methods, and standard conditions for direct-connected static prepayment alternating current (AC) meters of accuracy Class 1 and Class 2 for measuring active energy.

certification_and_marking.certification_status: No explicit BIS product certification (such as the ISI Mark or CRS Registration) is written in the provided excerpts of the standard text. However, to guarantee accuracy and functional safety, the code mandates strict technical markings, terminal specifications, and electrical verification limits:

requirements.detail: The meter must possess a correct constant declared by the manufacturer. Allowed errors in the meter constant must not exceed 0.10 percent for Class 1 meters and 0.20 percent for Class 2 meters.
Terminal holes must have minimum internal diameters matching the rated current: <= 40 A requires 5.5 mm; 40 A < I <= 60 A requires 8.0 mm; and > 60 A requires 9.5 mm.

Insulation resistance at 500 V d.c. must be at least 5 MΩ between all current/voltage/auxiliary circuits (> 40 V) connected together and earth, and at least 50 MΩ between individual circuits not intended to be connected in service.
Indoor meters must function accurately within a specified operating range of -10 °C to 55 °C, and withstand a storage and transport limit range of -25 °C to 70 °C.

requirements.requirement_type: Token Carrier Interface and Event Logging
requirements.detail: Prepayment meter interfaces or token carriers (magnetic cards, keypads, memory keys, etc.) must transfer credit values and reliably log events including credit expired, power limit exceeded, load switch status, and tamper detections.

plain_language_summary.summary: IS 15884:2024 is the national Indian Standard specification establishing technical, structural, and performance criteria for alternating current direct-connected static prepayment electricity meters of accuracy Class 1 and Class 2. This revision governs prepayment-specific features such as credit token interfaces (keypads, magnetic cards, or memory cards), real-time clock timekeeping, and load switching utilization categories (UC1, UC2, UC3). When implementing or testing these prepayment systems, engineers must verify electrical safety parameters—such as impulse voltage, AC voltage, and d.c. insulation resistance—as well as make sure that terminal block hole diameters and operational temperature limits (-10 °C to 55 °C) strictly comply with the standard's requirements.
